```
['run the GPMP controller ROS node for LoCoBot trajectory planning and execution', 'create a 2D signed distance field from an occupancy grid map using distance transforms', 'build a GPMP2 trajectory plan using GTSAM optimization with obstacle avoidance factors', 'review the Robot class which subscribes to odometry and occupancy grid topics for state tracking', 'test the GPMPController action server that replans trajectories to reach a goal pose']
```
